Picky — Vanilla-style "Selective Eater" Mod(SVE)

대확장의 콘텐츠는 즐기고 싶지만, 익숙한 바닐라 지도와 분위기도 그리운 분들을 위한 비공식 Content Patcher 패치입니다.
개인 플레이용으로 시작해, 원하는 요소를 남기고 일부 지도와 캐릭터 구성을 조정했습니다.

Originally developed for personal use, Picky adjusts selected maps and character content to bring a more familiar, vanilla-style atmosphere to SVE.
Picky is an unofficial Content Patcher mod for players who want to enjoy Stardew Valley Expanded while keeping the familiar atmosphere of the vanilla maps.

Originally developed for personal use, Picky adjusts selected maps and character content to bring a more familiar, vanilla-style atmosphere to SVE.

Not every area is reverted to vanilla. Outdoor maps have been given a more vanilla-inspired look while preserving SVE NPC homes and necessary travel routes.
Where possible, Picky relies on SVE’s existing content and progression, adding only the connections and detours needed for its map layout.

[b]Sophia and Scarlett can be toggled ON or OFF in the settings.[/b]

[b]With the setting ON[/b]
Blue Moon Vineyard and the two characters’ regular interactions and events remain based on SVE. This option is for players who want to enjoy their character content alongside Picky’s vanilla-style maps.

[b]With the setting OFF[/b]
With the admittedly self-indulgent idea that “this town only needs one big landowner,” Blue Moon Vineyard is removed from the town’s regular travel routes.
Sophia and Scarlett remain as visitors from a neighboring town, but are excluded from regular friendship interactions and random town requests.
They are not erased from the story. They still appear at festivals and in relevant events, and festival maps and attendance follow SVE. Their first greetings include a little context about coming from a neighboring town.
[list]
[*]On the standard farm, the path heading south past Grandpa’s Shed connects to the beach.[/*]
[*]With Sophia OFF, the town path that previously led toward the vineyard is initially blocked. After the late-game shortcut is unlocked, it connects to the forest near Andy’s farm. This connection adapts to SVE’s short-path and long-path settings.[/*]
[*]Some NPC schedules and events that previously used the vineyard are redirected to other locations when Sophia is OFF.[/*]
[*]Related scenes involving Gus and Claire, as well as dialogue from Olivia and Sandy, have been adjusted to reflect the new geography.[/*]
[*]Locations needed for events are retained, so some stories may still take you to the vineyard.[/*]
[*]With Sophia OFF, Blue Moon wine previously sold by Sophia can be purchased from Gus. With Sophia ON, she continues to sell it herself.[/*]
[/list][b]Shared Features: ON and OFF[/b]
Sophia and Scarlett’s friendship levels are excluded from the requirements for Perfection. The Cheese Charcuterie recipe can also be purchased from Gus once you reach three hearts with him.
[list]
[*]Certain dialogue and schedule adjustments apply regardless of the Sophia ON/OFF setting.[/*]
[*]Morgan’s four-heart event retains their original way of speaking and identity while adding an explanation that magic affects their appearance. The effects of magic and Morgan’s understanding of themself are presented as separate matters.[/*]
[*]One of Olivia’s schedules involving a visit to the Wizard’s Tower is replaced with painting at home.[/*]
[*]Some dialogue from the Wizard and Caroline has also been adjusted. Picky’s dialogue changes are available in both Korean and English.[/*]
[/list][b]Changing the ON/OFF Setting[/b]
Use the in-game mod configuration menu, or edit
[code]KeepSophiaScarlettContent[/code]in
[code]config.json[/code].
[code]false[/code]means OFF, and
[code]true[/code]means ON. The default is OFF.
[line]

[b]Requirements[/b]
Install SMAPI, Stardew Valley Expanded and its required dependencies, Content Patcher, and Cross-Mod Compatibility Tokens (CMCT) first.
This release was built using SVE 1.15.11 files and requires Content Patcher 2.9.0 or later and CMCT 1.1.2 or later.
[b]Installation[/b]
Extract the archive and place both
[code][CP] Picky SVE[/code]and
[code][SMAPI] Picky Runtime Repair[/code]in your
[code]Mods[/code]folder.

[b]!!SVE and CMCT are not included and must be installed separately!![/b]
[b]!!Please back up your existing saves and configuration before installing!![/b]

When updating, remove both old Picky folders before replacing them with the new versions.
After changing the Sophia setting or map-related options, fully close the game and SMAPI, then restart. Returning to the title screen alone is not sufficient.

[b]Compatibility with Ridgeside Village and other major expansion mods has not been tested.[/b]

[b]Existing Saves and Testing Coverage[/b]
Testing has been carried out in my personal Android setup using saves at different stages of progression. This included map travel, short-path and long-path connections, modified events, and some NPC schedules.

Some daily life and commuting behavior has also been checked in saves where the player was already married to Sophia with the setting OFF. However, this should not be taken as a guarantee that all marriage-related content is supported in that configuration.

The final changes were checked at the file and patch-condition level. Not every area, season, or late-game event has been tested through actual gameplay.

A full playthrough with Sophia ON, as well as PC and multiplayer testing, still needs further verification.

Mods that edit the same outdoor maps or NPC schedules may conflict. Personal testing with various quality-of-life mods and visual replacements does not guarantee compatibility with every combination or version.

Some gameplay has been checked with Looking for Love and RRRR installed together. In my tested setup, the Wizard’s romance and marriage options were disabled in both Looking for Love and SVE so that RRRR could provide that content.

Existing saves may retain trees or other vegetation that grew under the previous map layout.

[b]Bug Reports[/b]
Please include your full SMAPI log, Picky and SVE versions, device, Sophia ON/OFF setting, path setting, and the in-game date, time, and location where the issue occurred.
Screenshots and steps to reproduce the problem are also helpful.

[b]Development[/b]
This mod was made with assistance from ChatGPT/Codex. AI tools were used for patch coding, file analysis, dialogue editing, and compatibility checks. The creator directly edited maps and carried out in-game playtesting.
AI-assisted checks do not guarantee that every bug or compatibility issue has been resolved.

[b]Modification and Redistribution[/b]
You may freely modify and redistribute the code and changes I created, provided that you credit Picky and its creator, Larimarcode.
Please describe your changes and use a name or version label that clearly distinguishes your modified release from the original Picky.
This permission does not extend to maps, images, translations, or other third-party materials belonging to Stardew Valley, SVE, or other creators. Those materials remain subject to their respective creators’ terms.
